source.description: Reviewed handmade raster felt-tip marker process contact sheet.
source.notes: One right-facing hermit crab with one spiral shell, two claws, four visible walking legs, and an asymmetrical face; no labels, arrows, UI, signatures, watermarks, badge frame, or sticker outline.

process_strategy: Eight cumulative panels build a sparse shell-and-body scaffold into fixed claws, legs, eye stalks, spiral bands, expression, details, a complete marker color map, and a finishing-only pass.

progression_contract.blank_page_test: A beginner can copy Panel 1 in under two minutes using one pale shell oval, one shell center point, one small body oval, two eye-stalk routes, two claw routes, four leg attachment ticks, and one shadow route.

anchor_map.early_mark: One large tilted shell oval with one center point
anchor_map.becomes: The teal spiral shell with one yellow spiral and three curved shell bands
anchor_map.fixed_relationship: The shell remains behind the body, tilted up-left, and its lower-right opening stays attached over the crab's back.
anchor_map.construction_note: Allowed pale closed construction oval; no finished shell edge or spiral in Panel 1.

anchor_map.early_mark: One small right-facing body oval beneath the shell opening
anchor_map.becomes: The coral-orange crab head and chest
anchor_map.fixed_relationship: The body remains in front of the shell opening and points toward the page's right.
anchor_map.construction_note: Pale body mass only; no finished head contour or face in Panel 1.

anchor_map.becomes: Exactly two eye stalks with one wide eye and one half-lidded eye
anchor_map.fixed_relationship: Both stalks attach to the top of the body; the rear stalk stays slightly taller and neither changes attachment or direction.

anchor_map.early_mark: Two forward claw routes and four lower leg attachment ticks
anchor_map.becomes: One large raised front claw, one smaller forward claw, and exactly four visible walking legs
anchor_map.fixed_relationship: Both claws attach to the front half of the body; two walking legs emerge below each side of the body and remain under the shell overlap.
anchor_map.construction_note: Open routes and ticks only until their assigned panels.

final_elements.name: crab construction guides
final_elements.description: One shell oval and center, one body oval, two eye routes, two claw routes, four leg ticks, and one broken shadow route.

final_elements.name: shell and body silhouette
final_elements.description: One large tilted shell behind one compact right-facing crab body.

final_elements.name: two claws
final_elements.description: One large raised front claw and one smaller forward claw attached to the front body.

final_elements.name: two eye stalks and four walking legs
final_elements.description: Exactly two attached eye stalks and exactly four visible bent walking legs.

final_elements.name: shell pattern and asymmetrical face
final_elements.description: One broad shell spiral, exactly three curved shell bands, one wide eye, one half-lidded eye, offset pupils, one raised brow, one crooked one-tooth grin, and two cheek hatches.

final_elements.name: claw creases highlights and sand marks
final_elements.description: Two claw crease marks, two shell highlight reserves, exactly three short sand dashes, and one broken ground-shadow shape.

final_elements.name: marker palette and shadow
final_elements.description: Thick black outlines with coral-orange crab, teal shell, yellow spiral, raspberry bands, pale-aqua highlights, warm sand dashes, and navy shadow fully mapped before the finish.

overlap_reservations.background_lines_stop_before: The shell opening ends behind the crab body; leg and claw routes begin at visible body attachment points and no shell keeper line crosses through the body.
The large raised claw sits in front of the smaller claw and body; later crease lines stop inside the established claw silhouettes.

frames.visible_job: Place one tilted shell oval and center point, one small right-facing body oval, two eye-stalk routes, two claw routes, four leg attachment ticks, and one broken ground-placement route.
must_not_show: highlights sand dashes or dark ground fill

frames.visible_job: Connect the large tilted shell and compact right-facing body over their established guides, keeping the shell opening behind the body.
must_not_show: spiral bands face black ink color highlights sand dashes or filled shadow

frames.visible_job: Wrap the two established routes with one large raised front claw and one smaller forward claw, preserving both body attachment points.
must_not_show: spiral bands face details black ink color highlights sand dashes or filled shadow

frames.visible_job: Turn the two upper routes into exactly two eye stalks and the four lower ticks into exactly four bent walking legs.
introduces: two eye stalks and four walking legs
establishes: two eye stalks and four walking legs
must_not_show: pupils brow mouth cheek hatches shell spiral or bands black ink color highlights sand dashes or filled shadow

frames.visible_job: Add one broad shell spiral, exactly three curved shell bands, one wide eye, one half-lidded eye, offset pupils, one raised brow, one crooked one-tooth grin, and two cheek hatches.
must_not_show: claw creases shell highlights sand dashes filled shadow black ink or color
requires_prior_elements: two eye stalks and four walking legs

frames.visible_job: Add two claw creases, two shell highlight reserves, exactly three short sand dashes, and one broken shadow shape around the established crab.
introduces: claw creases highlights and sand marks
establishes: claw creases highlights and sand marks
must_not_show: black ink completed marker fills new anatomy shell bands facial features or props

frames.step_name: Ink and map the tide-pool colors
frames.visible_job: Ink every established contour and visibly map coral-orange, teal, yellow, raspberry, pale aqua, warm sand, and navy marker strokes in every planned region.
must_not_show: new anatomy shell bands face marks sand marks highlights props or color regions
requires_prior_elements: two eye stalks and four walking legs
claw creases highlights and sand marks

new_occlusions: The crab body sits in front of the shell opening.
The large raised claw overlaps the smaller claw and front body edge.
The four walking legs attach beneath the body and remain partly behind it.

must_persist: two eye stalks and four walking legs

final_step.visible_job: Only complete established marker fills, strengthen selected keeper contours, and clarify the same highlights, sand dashes, face, and broken shadow.
allowed_changes: small highlight face and shadow clarification

rejection_checks: Reject a detailed first panel, a moving shell-body attachment, or eye claw and leg guides that do not become their named parts in place.
Reject missing or extra eye stalks, claws, walking legs, shell bands, highlights, or sand dashes after those counts appear.
Reject a repeated dot-eye and U-smile face, vector-like fills, sticker or badge framing, or a final color region absent from Panel 7.
Reject labels, arrows, text, signatures, watermarks, extra props, changing viewpoint, or repeated darker tracings.
